items.fdcDescription: Biscuits, plain or buttermilk, prepared from recipe
items.notes: Manual semantic review binds Cook4Me 'Biscuits for coffee' to USDA SR Legacy 'Biscuits, plain or buttermilk, prepared from recipe'. The target is generically a biscuit and its own pinned evidence contains this generic biscuit record. Confidence remains medium because 'for coffee' does not identify the exact biscuit recipe, sweetness, fat, or flavor; this review does not generalize to cookies, wafers, crackers, or filled biscuits.

items.fdcDescription: Biscuits, plain or buttermilk, prepared from recipe
items.notes: Manual semantic review binds Cook4Me 'Crushed biscuits' to USDA SR Legacy 'Biscuits, plain or buttermilk, prepared from recipe'. Crushing changes only physical form and the target's own pinned evidence contains this generic biscuit record. Confidence remains medium because biscuit style, recipe, sugar, fat, and buttermilk content are unspecified; this review does not generalize to cookies, crackers, filled biscuits, or flavored sandwich biscuits.

Manual semantic review binds Cook4Me 'Dried wood ear mushrooms' to USDA FNDDS 'Mushrooms, raw'. The target is explicitly a mushroom ingredient and its own pinned evidence contains this generic mushroom record. Confidence remains medium because the USDA record does not preserve wood-ear species or dried state, so dehydration and species-specific nutrient differences are not represented; this review does not generalize to stuffed, fried, pickled, or unrelated mushrooms.

Manual semantic review binds Cook4Me 'Smoked duck, chopped' to USDA FNDDS 'Duck, cooked, skin eaten'. The target is explicitly duck and chopping does not change identity; its own pinned evidence contains this cooked-duck record. Confidence remains medium because smoking, sodium, moisture loss, exact cut, and skin proportion are not represented; this review does not generalize to duck sauce, duck egg, or non-duck smoked foods.

Manual semantic review binds Cook4Me 'Veal brisket' to USDA FNDDS 'Veal, chop'. The target is explicitly veal and its own pinned evidence contains this veal record. Confidence remains medium because brisket and chop differ in cut and fat distribution; cooking state and trimming are also unspecified, so this is a same-species nutritional proxy rather than an exact cut match.

Manual semantic review binds Cook4Me 'Veal carpaccio' to USDA FNDDS 'Veal, chop'. The target is explicitly veal and its own pinned evidence contains this veal record. Confidence remains medium because carpaccio is typically a different cut and may be raw or lightly dressed, while the USDA category is a generic veal chop; cut, cooking state, trimming, and dressing are not represented.
